prompt: Create a side-by-side comparison diptych of two ultra-realistic cinematic editorial portraits of the same confident young adult Black man with short closely cropped black hair, warm brown skin, oval face, full lips, and round thin metal eyeglasses standing against a rich burnt-orange textured stucco wall. Canvas is square, split into exactly 2 vertical portrait panels with a thin clean white divider at the center. Left panel: waist-to-chest-up portrait, subject centered and facing forward, calm confident expression, direct eye contact, visible upper torso. Right panel: tighter chest-up portrait, subject positioned slightly right of center, body turned three-quarter to the left while looking directly at camera, face larger in frame. Wardrobe: dark navy pinstripe suit jacket over a black turtleneck, polished editorial styling. Lighting: strong golden-hour sunlight from upper left, dramatic high-contrast shadows, large window-frame shadow grid falling across the orange wall and partially over the subject, crisp dark cast shadows, warm highlights on skin and glasses. Background: rough plaster texture, saturated burnt orange, no props. Camera and style: photorealistic fashion magazine portrait, shallow depth of field but face sharp, natural skin texture, realistic reflections in round glasses, 85mm lens look, cinematic contrast, rich warm color grading, professional editorial composition. Constraints: exactly two panels, same person in both panels, no text, no logos, no watermark, no extra people, no distorted eyeglasses or facial features.

promptZh: 创作一张并排对比的双联画，展示两张超逼真的电影级时尚编辑肖像，主角均为同一位自信的年轻人 留着短寸黑发、拥有暖棕色皮肤、椭圆形脸庞、嘴唇丰满并佩戴细框圆眼镜的黑人男性，背景为质感丰富的焦橙色灰泥墙。画布为正方形，垂直平分为 2 个肖像面板，中间由一条细而整洁的白色线条隔开。左侧面板：腰部以上肖像，主角居中并面向前方，神情冷静自信，直视镜头，可见上半身。右侧面板：更紧凑的胸部以上肖像，主角位置略微偏右，身体向左侧转四分之三，同时直视镜头，面部在画面中占比更大。服装：深海军蓝细条纹西装外套内搭黑色高领毛衣，精致的编辑风格造型。光影：来自左上方的强烈黄金时刻阳光，戏剧性的高对比度阴影，巨大的窗框阴影网格投射在橙色墙面上并部分覆盖在主角身上，清晰的深色投影，皮肤和眼镜上有温暖的高光。背景：粗糙的灰泥纹理，饱和的焦橙色，无道具。相机与风格：照片级真实的时尚杂志肖像，浅景深但面部清晰，自然的皮肤纹理，圆眼镜中真实的反射，85mm 镜头感，电影级对比度，浓郁的暖色调，专业的编辑构图。限制：必须为两个面板，两个面板中为同一人，无文字，无 Logo，无水印，无额外人物，眼镜或面部特征不得变形。
